about: Each tracked group's nonprofit arm that files Form 990 (its 501(c)(4), (5) or (6), the one that does its politics), by IRS employer ID (EIN), for scripts/build-990.mjs. Looked up in ProPublica's Nonprofit Explorer and the IRS's e-file index on Nov. 18, 2026. A group missing here has no such filer confirmed: a PAC files only with the FEC.

aflcio.name: American Federation of Labor & Congress of Industrial Orgs

chamber.name: Chamber of Commerce of the United States of America

nfib.name: National Federation of Independent Business Inc

nrlc.name: National Right to Life Committee Inc

acu.name: Credit Union National Association Inc (now America's Credit Unions)

nea.name: National Education Association of the United States

phrma.name: Pharmaceutical Research and Manufacturers of America

sba.name: Susan B Anthony List Inc (SBA Pro-Life America)

everytown.name: Everytown for Gun Safety Action Fund Inc

notFound.afscme: The national union's own 990 filer isn't confirmed: several AFSCME councils share the name.
notFound.scf: Senate Conservatives Fund is a PAC; no nonprofit arm found.
notFound.fairshake: A super PAC network; super PACs file with the FEC, not the IRS.
notFound.cffe: Campaign for a Family Friendly Economy: no nonprofit filer found by that name.
